comments.note: ClassCache.php — Maintainability: The docblock has been correctly trimmed to only retain annotations that add value beyond the native type declaration: @phpstan-param class-string|null $instanceOf (narrowing that ?string cannot express), @return class-string[] (array element type refinement), and @throws FileHelper_Exception (propagated exception documentation). No redundant @param lines remain. Clean and minimal.

Best Practices: The constraints.md rule for PHP 8.4 native union types is well-formed and actionable. It correctly carves out the @phpstan-param exception for class-string narrowing, providing future developers with enough guidance to apply the rule consistently without over-annotating.

Security & Performance: Moving from docblock-only annotation to a native union type is a runtime safety improvement. Invalid argument types now produce a PHP TypeError at the method boundary rather than propagating silently. No performance implications.

Non-blocking suggestion: The $instanceOf parameter has no @param description explaining its purpose (filter results to instances of a given class). Since ClassCache is an internal utility and the @phpstan-param covers analysis needs, this is acceptable as-is. A future pass could add a brief description for IDE tooling benefit.
